svg.title: One node, one decision
svg.desc: The LOD walk is pure CPU and asks one question per node: how wide does this node's point spacing land on screen? Wider than lod_px and the walk descends, picking up the finer subsample each child owns. No wider, and the node is drawn whole from its own subsample and nothing below it is read.
svg.text: this node's spacing — too wide, so its eight children are visited too
spacing fits: draw the node whole
this node's spacing — fits, so the node itself is drawn
Each node owns its subsample, so descending only adds detail; the finest spacing found below a node travels back up to size the discs it is drawn with.
